scripts.test:all: cd packages/app && flutter test && cd ../.. && npm -w @sidesa/crypto test && npm -w @sidesa/backend test && npm run build:all
scripts.build:all: npm run build:crypto && npm run build:backend
scripts.db:up: docker start sidesa-pg || docker run --name sidesa-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=devpass -e POSTGRES_DB=sidesa -p 5432:5432 -d postgres:16
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma generate
scripts.backend:dev: npm run build:crypto && npm -w @sidesa/backend run start:dev
